faq1Q: How can I become a member?
faq1A: Attend one of our projects or send us a message through this form. We welcome new members who share our passion for community service — no experience needed.
faq2Q: Do I need prior volunteering experience?
faq2A: Not at all. We provide training and guidance for every project. The only requirement is showing up.
faq3Q: How often does the club meet?
faq3A: General meetings happen twice a month, with project-specific meetings as needed. Check our projects page for the schedule.
faq4Q: Can I donate to support your projects?
faq4A: Yes — donations directly fund our community initiatives. Contact us and we'll walk you through how to contribute.
faq5A: A nominal annual fee covers administrative costs and supports our service projects. No one is turned away for inability to pay.
